title: Layout templates for signage
slide_intent: Identify the production tools for signs because contributors need editable sources before adapting a physical layout.
strategic_value: The InDesign and Illustrator route can help Helsinki signage creators begin from shared material.
demonstration: This webpage component contains the Layout templates for signage heading, a short InDesign/Illustrator file description and an Open all control. No template artwork appears.
practical_value: Locate the signage template section for the required design tool.
